mapper.select: SELECT cart_id FROM cart WHERE user_id = #{userId}

SELECT ci.cart_item_id AS itemId, ci.cart_id AS cartId, ci.product_id AS productId, ci.quantity AS quantity, ci.added_at AS addedAt, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.image_url AS imageUrl FROM cart_item ci INNER JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.product_id WHERE ci.cart_id = #{cartId} ORDER BY ci.cart_item_id DESC
SELECT cart_item_id AS itemId, cart_id AS cartId, product_id AS productId, quantity AS quantity FROM cart_item WHERE cart_id = #{cartId} AND product_id = #{productId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item (cart_id, product_id, quantity) VALUES (#{cartId}, #{productId}, #{quantity})
mapper.select: SELECT ci.cart_item_id AS itemId, ci.cart_id AS cartId, ci.product_id AS productId, ci.quantity AS quantity, p.name AS name, p.price AS price, p.stock AS stock FROM cart_item ci INNER JOIN products p ON ci.product_id = p.product_id WHERE ci.cart_item_id = #{cartItemId}
